opening_message:
Ticket 1: Ashley Roberts (employee ID E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E016.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Ashley Roberts (E016), Analyst, full-time. Requested write access to Payroll. As a full-time employee, max is write (admin only if their role owns the system; Analyst does not own Payroll). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E016 (Ashley Roberts) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time as previously noted. Contractor with basic training: max access is read (write requires advanced training). Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.
reason: Security agent's note corrects the record: E016 (Ashley Roberts) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time. Per policy, contractor maximum is read (write requires advanced security training; never admin). Requested write exceeds the maximum, so grant the maximum: read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Ashley Roberts (E016), requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR says: Analyst, full_time, recommends write for Payroll.
- Security says: Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommends read for Payroll.

There's a conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor. Security agent notes "Security DB shows E016 is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time as previously noted."

For contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training -> max is read.

The requested level is write. Per policy, if requested level is above maximum, grant maximum. So grant read.

The Security agent's DB note seems to be the more authoritative correction. The max for this employee is read. So decision: read.

I'll submit read.
